description: This file defines the main game screen for a Tic Tac Toe Flutter application. It manages game state, user interactions, rendering of the game board, status updates, and reset functionality. It includes UI layout, game logic, and integration with custom widgets.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the gameplay screen, including app bar, game board, status bar, and reset button.

classes.name: _GameScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the game logic, user interactions, and UI updates for GameScreen.

methods.name: _resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board, current player, game state, and winning line indicators.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks the current board for a winner or a draw, updates game state accordingly.

methods.name: _onTapCell
methods.description: Handles user taps on a cell, updates game state if move is valid.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current game status.

methods.name: _statusAccent
methods.description: Returns a color representing the current game status for UI emphasis.

methods.name: _isWinningCell
methods.description: Checks if a cell index is part of the winning line.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget tree including background, app bar, game board, status bar, and reset button.

methods.name: _buildBoard
methods.description: Constructs the 3x3 grid of game tiles, handling visual updates based on game state.
